author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Staff,


sorry for any confusion but that was not a false leaving thread. My comment on nemo's post was a joke because everyone was expecting me to come back after my infraction had expired. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Regards,

DaCrowMan

title: My temp-ban

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
You've lost your credibility, especially to make jokes now.

You've already spammed the forums enough and adding insult to injury, making with certainty that you seemed you were coming back, is deserved with a punishment.

replies.author: iKronix_Gaming
replies.body: Oh come on please allow me back. I was more just talking to Nemo, not to everyone. I'm going on holiday on the 15th of August and my birthday is on the 14th of August. This means I can't play for the rest of the holidays for making a small joke to a friend? Please accept me back.

replies.body: It was all a joke, I'm sorry if it looked like I meant it. I was trying to make an innocent joke and you temp-ban me for over 20 days?

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
That's how the rule works. I'm a moderator, I enforce it.

It's a relevant punishment because the forums are a service meant for discussing the server, and since you say you left the server, it goes directly in hand with the general rules in the first place for personal updates. I really don't consider it a joke at all, and it's not detectable at all in your post. There's a logic involved.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
